'''Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition''' was the fiftieth edition of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'', published in the fiftieth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the company's operation. The special anniversary issue included a forward written by [[Unidentified Galladinium president|the president of the company]], as well as an insert of "Special Offerings" that was available exclusively to [[Galladinium Preferred Customers|Galladinium's Preferred Customers]]. Several coupons were offered that were valid until the publication of the [[Galladinium's 51st edition|51st edition]].<ref name="GFT" />
